# Probe for the go-31948 bench: the steps of clean_cache_lock.txt that remove
# a cache another live go command (or the cleaning one itself) has mmapped,
# run on both the base and the patched toolchain. Every step may fail; the
# logs say which ones do.

[short] skip

env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache

? go test -count=1 -v .
? go run ./cleaner
? go clean -i -cache

-- go.mod --
module example

go 1.24
-- main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(0) }
-- clean_test.go --
package main

import (
	"os/exec"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestCleanInTest(t *testing.T) {
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		out, err := exec.Command("go", "clean", "-cache").CombinedOutput()
		if err != nil {
			t.Logf("go clean -cache: %s", out)
		}
		done <- err
	}()
	select {
	case err := <-done:
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	case <-time.After(time.Minute):
		t.Fatal("go clean -cache waited for its own go test")
	}
}
-- cleaner/main.go --
package main

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
)

func main() {
	cmd := exec.Command("go", "clean", "-cache")
	cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
